title: Home
text:
We’re building the perception platform for developers.



Perception capabilities are often complex and brittle; our platform helps make them plug-and-play. Our SDKs fuse LiDAR, IMU, GNSS, and camera data alongside GPU-accelerated processing, calibration, and analytics. We focus on developer experience as much as core capability so that developers can deliver perception without reinventing the stack.
Spun out of MIT and Stripe, we bring together cutting-edge research with a deep understanding of developer-first platforms. Our aim is not just to push perception metrics, but to translate them into product features that help developers solve real-world problems—making perception an accessible and dependable layer for every application.

title: Join
text:

Join us!



Join the team responsible for building the core vision and sensor fusion capabilities that enable hardware to perceive the world in real time. We design, implement, and optimize perception algorithms that ensure robust operation across diverse environments and conditions.
As a Research Engineer, you will develop and deploy state-of-the-art perception systems for real-time, closed-loop control. You’ll own the full stack from sensor ingest and calibration to on-device optimization and clean system interfaces, collaborating closely with camera, systems, and controls teams to ship features that perform reliably in the wild.
We’re looking for people who thrive at the intersection of computer vision, robotics, and systems engineering—engineers who can balance algorithmic depth with practical deployment on constrained hardware.
